name: W Austin
positioning: A music-centric downtown Austin hotel in the 2nd Street District beside the Austin City Limits venue, with Scott Newton's music photography in every room and a 4th-floor WET deck pool
best_for: Music lovers who want to be beside the Austin City Limits venue
Groups who want two-bedroom suites in downtown Austin

facts.text: Rooms have hardwood floors, a Marshall speaker and blue-green wall and ceiling paint that reflects Lady Bird Lake.
All suites include nightly turndown service, a personalized concierge, an espresso machine and upgraded bath products.
Some suites have a personal terrace overlooking the rooftop pool.
The Blue Room is a by-reservation cocktail bar inside the hotel.
W Austin is part of Block 21, a LEED-certified mixed-occupancy project.
AWAY Spa has seven treatment rooms and an art installation by local artist Jennifer Prichard.
The two-bedroom Penthouse I has a soaking tub, a living room and dining table seating up to 8, and lake and city views.

highlights.text: Scott Newton's photographs of Austin's music scene can be seen in each guest room.
The hotel is in Austin's 2nd Street District, with a front-row seat to the Austin City Limits music venue.
The WET deck pool on the 4th floor has private cabanas, lounge chairs, tanning shelves, a fireplace and two outdoor showers.

considerations.text: The minimum age to check in is 21.
WhataHotel notes the high-energy, party atmosphere may not suit all travelers.
